Build prompt

Rebuild this interaction 1:1: Revolut's money protected loop - under "YOUR MONEY, PROTECTED - PERIOD.", a glass security cube descends over a stack of metallic coins on a base plate, seals, lifts away, and the loop repeats.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
A white screen: "Welcome to Revolut" eyebrow, bold headline "YOUR MONEY, PROTECTED - PERIOD.", then the isometric hero - a tall stack of dark silver coins standing on a square platform with blue and green corner pads - and "Log in" / "Sign up" pills below.

## Motion spec
Pattern: glass cube enclosure loop.
- The coin stack idles on the platform (very slight rotation, 10s turn, or static with shifting highlights).
- A transparent glass cube descends from above (translateY, 600ms, ease-out with a soft settle at contact) until it fully encloses the coin stack, its base meeting the platform.
- Sealed state: the cube's glass edges catch a brighter specular line (a quick highlight sweep, 300ms) - the "locked in" beat. Hold ~1s.
- The cube lifts away (translateY back up, 600ms, ease-in) and the loop repeats after a short pause.
- The platform's blue and green pads glow subtly while the cube is sealed.

## Calibration
- The cube is barely there - thin glass edges and a faint top face; the coins stay fully readable through it.
- The descent is smooth with a 2px settle bounce at contact - it should feel like precision machinery.

## Reduced motion
Cube fades in over the coins, holds, fades out.

## Don't miss
- The coin stack has real ridges - individual coins readable, not a smooth cylinder.
- Reflections on the glass cube slide along its edges during the descent.
